reply_text:
Reviewed `receipt-lines` against `main` at `a6c40d4`. **I’d fix these before merging:**

1. **[P1] Printed amounts are 100× too large** — `receipt/render.py:2`  
   `format_money` formats integer cents directly as dollars. `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00` instead of `$12.99`; two $4.50 coffees print as `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`. Convert cents to dollars when formatting. Add a literal expected-value assertion: the current rendering test uses `format_money(900)` as its expectation, so it reproduces and hides the same bug.

2. **[P2] The renderer bypasses the new right-alignment helper** — `receipt/render.py:7`  
   `render_line` pads the name to 20 characters rather than using the 32-column `align` helper. Amounts therefore start at the same column but end at different columns as their lengths vary—the printed amount column isn’t right-aligned. Wire the helper into rendering and test rendered lines with different amount lengths.

All **3 existing tests pass**, despite these issues. No source changes made; working tree is clean.
